Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Multiple relevant laws exist: Data Protection Act 2012; Right to Information Act 2019; Payment Systems and Services Act 2019; National Data Sharing Policy (not yet a formal Act but comprehensive). Ghana Government Enterprise Architecture Framework 2022. eGIF v2.0 under stakeholder review. National Data Governance Framework 2024 in development. Legislation for cross-government data sharing exists but consolidated interoperability law not yet enacted.

revision_notes: The specific instrument that would establish legal authority for cross-government data sharing and govern a data exchange system — NITA's Data Harmonisation Bill, which creates the National Data Exchange Platform — was still in public consultation (closed 14 November 2025) and had not been passed by Parliament; existing laws (Data Protection Act 2012, RTI Act 2019) are related but do not themselves establish or govern a cross-government data exchange. Downgraded from Yes (3) to Under development (2).

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Open Government Partnership action planning has been adopted by Ghana's subnational administrations including at municipal assembly level. Ghana.gov is used at the national level with some sub-national participation. However, the DIAL study notes a decentralized approach with fragmented initiatives across MDAs. Sub-national participation is partial rather than full.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Corroborated with a second source: the District Development Data Platform (DDDP), used by all 261 MMDAs since 2019 with a steering committee formed in November 2024 to scale it up, and a 2025 GIZ terms-of-reference document describing plans to interoperate DDDP with GIFMIS and LUPMIS. This confirms genuine but still-developing sub-national participation. Confirmed at Partial Participation (4), no change.

Comments: GODI Secretariat (housed in NITA since 2010) promotes transparency and accountability; 315 catalogs from 22 agencies publicly available. Right to Information Act 2019 enacted. Annual reports published. Ghana's comfort with open/transparent data practices noted by DIAL study. No dedicated public dashboard for data exchange operations but significant open data infrastructure.
